context.summary: Personal-use polish of the open_health iOS app (worktree open_health-redesign, branch feat/ios-redesign). Round 1 baad169 (copy, Advanced sync, launch, skeleton, large text, icon). Round 2 077cda1 (Trends page, 7-day card, score history, report switch in content).
context.next: Nothing pending. Possible later: web dashboard restyle, home-screen widget.

title: iOS frontend polish for daily personal use

nodes.label: Launch screen colour
nodes.detail: LaunchBackground still uses the old warm paper colour, so the app flashes before the grey grouped background. Match systemGroupedBackground in light and dark.

nodes.label: App icon refresh
nodes.evidence: draw_app_icon.swift -> 1024 opaque PNG, reviewed; asset compiles
nodes.detail: Redraw the 1024 icon in the new style: three concentric score rings (readiness teal, sleep indigo, activity orange) on a dark gradient. Generated locally, no external assets.

nodes.label: Plain-language copy
nodes.evidence: sim screenshot: Highlights sentence; jargon strings replaced; 37 tests pass
nodes.detail: Replace developer text: the torch-build note on model-free nights, jargon (RMSSD, MET, PWV, segments, fragmentation /h) and the +0% digest. Keep numbers; explain them in words.

nodes.label: Diagnostics → Advanced
nodes.evidence: sim screenshots: sync sheet at medium detent, Advanced page with history/logs/reset
nodes.detail: Sync sheet keeps status, Sync Now, and the link policy. Logs, crashes, older sessions, copy diagnostics, and reset move into an Advanced page. Settings moves the auth key there too.

nodes.label: Loading placeholders
nodes.evidence: builds; not seen on screen (pairing cover hides first load in the unpaired sim)
nodes.detail: First launch shows grey placeholder cards in the Summary layout with a shimmer instead of a bare spinner. Reduce Motion: no shimmer.

nodes.label: Large text layouts
nodes.evidence: sim at accessibility-extra-large: rings as rows, cards stack, no overflow
nodes.detail: At accessibility text sizes the three-ring row and the two-column vitals grid stack vertically; rings grow with the text.

nodes.label: Simulator check + phone
nodes.evidence: 37 iOS tests pass; installed + launched on iPhone 15 Pro Max; baad169 pushed
nodes.detail: Unit tests, screenshots in light, dark and AX sizes, then device build, install, commit, push.

nodes.label: Report tab switch in content
nodes.evidence: sim screenshot: full-width switch under the date
nodes.detail: Move the Sleep/Activity segmented control from the toolbar principal slot (clipped by the glass capsule) into the page under the date title, full width.

nodes.label: TrendChart + series
nodes.evidence: sim: bars + lines render, selection, no clipped labels, flat-line span fixed
nodes.detail: One Swift Charts view for bars or lines over dated values with a date domain, optional reference line, and tap-to-read selection; Summary extension turns scores, nights, activity_daily and vitals into dated series.

nodes.label: Trends page
nodes.evidence: sim: 7D default, score/sleep/activity/vital cards with phone data
nodes.detail: Period picker (7D-All); cards for Readiness, Sleep, Activity scores, time in bed with sleep need, steps, active energy, and the four vitals (tap into the vital page).

nodes.label: Summary Trends card
nodes.evidence: sim: 3 mini rows + averages; tap on chart opens Trends
nodes.detail: Last 7 days: one mini bar row per score with the average; opens the Trends page with a zoom.

nodes.label: Score detail history
nodes.evidence: sim: Activity 30-day chart, avg 78 over 3 days
nodes.detail: ScoreDetailView gains a 30-day chart of that score under the ring.

nodes.label: Sim + phone check
nodes.evidence: 37 tests pass; installed + launched on iPhone; 077cda1 pushed
nodes.detail: Screenshots of report, Trends, score detail; tests; device install; commit and push.
